subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should ordinary agent writes expose append as `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or should this PR be reshaped to use `mode` or a dedicated append tool before merge?
rationale: Source and user reports establish the need for a first-class append primitive, but the permanent model-facing tool contract is a maintainer-owned product/API choice.

options.title: Accept boolean append
options.body: Land this PR after exact-head review if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

options.title: Change the API shape
options.body: Ask for a `mode` field or dedicated append tool if maintainers prefer a more explicit or extensible write contract.

options.title: Supersede with another candidate
options.body: Use another open append PR only if maintainers choose it as the canonical landing path and preserve this PR's coverage and edge-case fixes.

recommendation.title: Accept boolean append
recommendation.body: Land this PR after exact-head review if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the listed project lead and have feature-history on the structured tool-definition/API surface.
